question: What attributes characterize the form constituted by Brahmā limbs in this visualization?
premises: The form is endowed with thirty-eight kalās.
The form is made of Brahmā limbs.
Both attributes qualify the same visualized figure.
inference: The visualized form possesses thirty-eight kalās and is constituted by the limbs of Brahmā.
plain_english: He is endowed with thirty-eight kalās and has a form made of the limbs of Brahmā.
